content: Chart creation must use exact selected range, not default to row 1: Extract startRow from selected range's startCell (e.g., 'A15' → '15'), use exact range `${colLetter}${startRow}:${colLetter}${endRow}`. Also: (1) seriesBy must be 'Columns' not 'Auto' - use `'Columns'` in sheet.charts.add(); (2) Add column offset when range doesn't start at A - parse startColIdx from address, compute adjusted column letters; (3) All charts need ≥2 columns (labels + values); (4) Use else-if chains for chart types (`isPieRequest`, `isBarRequest`, `isLineRequest`) to prevent multiple charts; (5) Always use full selected range for chart data, never individual columns. These fixes prevent wrong column auto-selection after chart creation.
